dc_eval_cbrn.quote: On the multimodal virology evaluation (VCT), Opus 5.5 achieved a score of 0.59, scoring above Claude Opus 5 (0.55) and on par with Claude Mythos 5.1 (0.58).
dc_eval_cbrn.note: VCT score; also CB-2 threshold determination.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Claude Opus 5.5 completed 67.6% of all challenges, the strongest performance of any model released to date.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: we assess that Claude Opus 5.5 does not cross the next capability threshold in our RSP and FCF
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D threshold determination; CoBench 55.8%, METR findings.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Based on our findings, Claude Opus 5.5 demonstrates operational capability in running influence campaigns, but its effectiveness against real humans has not been established.
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Influence-operation eval scores and Tier 2 determination under FCF harmful manipulation.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Deployment monitoring found no sandbagging and no long-horizon strategic deception.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Sandbagging, SHADE-Arena/LinuxArena stealth, evaluation awareness results.

framework_threshold.quote: We conclude that Claude Opus 5.5 does not cross the CB-2 threshold
framework_threshold.note: Model placed against RSP/FCF CB-1/CB-2 thresholds.

ext_test_any.quote: We conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude Opus 5.5's capabilities with METR
ext_test_any.note: Outside testing; also Trajectory Labs, 10a Labs, Gray Swan, Frontier Design, Dyno.

ext_test_named_org.quote: We conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude Opus 5.5's capabilities with METR

ext_test_government.quote: We collaborated with the U.S. Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) on measurement of cyber and biological capabilities and safeguards
ext_test_government.note: Government body tested the model; no post-release timing stated.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude Opus 5.5's capabilities with METR

safeguards_training.quote: underwent rigorous post-training and fine-tuning aimed at making it an assistant whose behavior aligns with the values described in Claude's constitution

safeguards_runtime.quote: we have deployed the same research biology classifiers in use for our deployments of Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1

safeguards_access.quote: The safeguards described here apply to the generally available model; verified cybersecurity users will be able to access the same model with fewer restrictions
safeguards_access.note: Cyber Verification Program: access tier tied to cyber risk.

safeguards_weights.note: No stated protection of this model's weights. Weight mentions are an audit metric (cooperation with exfiltration requests), deprecation/preservation, and steering; sandbox-escape classifier during evals is not weight security.
